title: Acute Viral Upper Respiratory Presentation in Healthy Adult

history.chief_complaint: Fever, dry cough, sore throat, and muscle aches for 2 days

examination_findings.physical_exam: Mild pharyngeal erythema without follicular exudate. Lungs clear to auscultation bilaterally.

missing_features: Loss of taste or smell not reported

expected_followup_questions: Have you lost your sense of taste or smell?
Is your cough dry or producing thick yellow/green mucus?
Do you have a runny or blocked nose?
Has anyone around you in your household or workplace been ill recently?
expected_safety_checks: Verify patient age (29) before NSAID/Paracetamol recommendation
Confirm no active peptic ulcer disease or renal impairment
expected_do_not_recommend: Empiric systemic antibiotics (e.g. Amoxicillin, Azithromycin) without bacterial evidence
Codeine cough suppressants in non-severe presentations
failure_analysis: Diagnosis mismatch (Expected 'None', Top 3 AI: ['viral upper respiratory infection', 'influenza (flu)', 'covid-19'])
